description: Population-genetic test of whether UNC119 p.Gly22Val can be a dominant cause of ICL
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Whiffin et al. 2017 (PMID 28518168) maximum credible allele frequency
# framework applied to UNC119 c.65G>T (p.Gly22Val), rs199714731,
# the variant reported as a dominant-negative cause of ICL (PMID 22184408).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Observed gnomAD v4 frequencies
obs = {
 "gnomAD v4 exomes, African/African-American": (619, 30364),
 "gnomAD v4 genomes, African/African-American": (916, 41572),
 "gnomAD v4 exomes, global":  (877, 1417996),
 "gnomAD v4 genomes, global": (971, 152248),
}
rows=[]
for k,(ac,an) in obs.items():
    lo,hi = stats.beta.ppf([0.025,0.975], ac+0.5, an-ac+0.5)
    rows.append({"dataset":k,"AC":ac,"AN":an,"AF":ac/an,"CI_low":lo,"CI_high":hi})
af = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(af.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.3e}"))

# Max credible AF for an autosomal dominant allele:
#   maxAF = prevalence * max_allelic_fraction * (1/penetrance) / 2
def max_cred_af(prev, allelic, pen):
    return prev*allelic/pen/2.0

scen = [
 # (label, disease prevalence, max fraction of cases from this single allele, penetrance)
 ("Reported ICL prevalence-like (1/100,000), single allele explains all cases, full penetrance", 1e-5, 1.0, 1.0),
 ("Generous: 1/10,000 prevalence, all cases, 50% penetrance", 1e-4, 1.0, 0.5),
 ("Extremely generous: 1/10,000, all cases, 10% penetrance", 1e-4, 1.0, 0.10),
 ("Absurdly generous: 1/1,000, all cases, 5% penetrance", 1e-3, 1.0, 0.05),
]
print("\nMaximum credible allele frequency under autosomal dominant inheritance")
afr_low = af.loc[af.dataset.str.contains("genomes, African"),"CI_low"].values[0]
for lab,p,a,pen in scen:
    m = max_cred_af(p,a,pen)
    print(f"  {lab}\n     maxAF = {m:.2e}   | observed AFR lower 95% bound = {afr_low:.2e}  -> ratio obs/max = {afr_low/m:,.0f}x")

# Homozygotes: a dominant-negative allele causing immunodeficiency should be depleted of homozygotes
print("\nHomozygotes in gnomAD v4: 12 (genomes) + 5 (exomes) = 17 homozygous individuals.")
n_afr_g = 41572//2
p_afr = 916/41572
print(f"Hardy-Weinberg expected homozygotes among {n_afr_g:,} AFR genomes: {n_afr_g*p_afr**2:.1f}")

# Power of the original study's control panel (60 healthy subjects = 120 alleles)
for lab, p in [("African-ancestry controls", 0.0220), ("European-ancestry controls", 0.00009), ("global", 0.00062)]:
    p0 = stats.binom.pmf(0, 120, p)
    print(f"P(0 carrier alleles among 60 controls | AF={p:.5f}, {lab}) = {p0:.3f}")

# ---- figure ----
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
labels = ["AFR\ngenomes","AFR\nexomes","Global\ngenomes","Global\nexomes"]
vals   = [916/41572, 619/30364, 971/152248, 877/1417996]
errlo  = [v - stats.beta.ppf(0.025, ac+0.5, an-ac+0.5) for v,(ac,an) in zip(vals,[(916,41572),(619,30364),(971,152248),(877,1417996)])]
errhi  = [stats.beta.ppf(0.975, ac+0.5, an-ac+0.5) - v for v,(ac,an) in zip(vals,[(916,41572),(619,30364),(971,152248),(877,1417996)])]
ax.bar(labels, vals, yerr=[errlo,errhi], color="#4C72B0", capsize=4, width=0.6)
for lab,p,a,pen in scen:
    m=max_cred_af(p,a,pen)
    ax.axhline(m, ls="--", lw=1.2, color="#C44E52")
    ax.text(3.45, m*1.12, f"maxAF {m:.0e}", ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=8, color="#C44E52")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("Allele frequency (log scale)")
ax.set_title("UNC119 c.65G>T p.Gly22Val (rs199714731) in gnomAD v4 vs maximum\ncredible allele frequency for a dominant cause of idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia")
ax.text(0.02,0.96,"Dashed lines: maxAF under four increasingly permissive\nprevalence and penetrance assumptions (most permissive on top)",
        transform=ax.transAxes, va="top", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
